prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: botanical realism reference plate for refining procedural crop models, not production textures. Make a high resolution landscape botanical photographic contact sheet, 4 columns by 3 rows, twelve distinct labelled panels, neutral light grey backdrop, side and three-quarter views, natural diffuse daylight, living stems visible and all leaves physically connected. Panels: 1 Wheat and winter rye: slender culms with alternating two-ranked arching leaves and grains attached along a continuous spike rachis. 2 Rice and millet: connected branching drooping panicles. 3 Garden pea: paired oval leaflets on rachises, young folded leaves upright, curling terminal tendrils, supported pods. 4 Bean and soybean: trifoliate leaves, terminal leaflet larger, lateral leaflets individually tilted, no repeated planar clovers. 5 Cotton: alternate lobed blades and woody branches, attached bolls with soft flyaway cotton lint and brown split valves. 6 Andean potato: branching herb with pinnate leaves, outward spreading pale violet star flowers with yellow anther cones. 7 Sunflower: broad serrated cordate leaves alternating up a stem and a supported head. 8 Rosette roots and taro: basal leaves of different ages, curved petioles, no floating leaves. 9 Cassava and castor: palmate leaves with independent leaflet tilt. 10 Banana: overlapping pseudostem, unfurling central cigar leaf, broad arching torn blades and hanging connected fruit hands. 11 Oil palm and coconut: fronds in age cohorts, older arch outward, young spear erect, leaflets vary along curved rachises. 12 Cacao and coffee: cacao has a short upright trunk with five irregular spreading fan branches and drooping elongated leaves, copper new flush, ribbed pods on trunk and older wood; coffee has opposite leaves. Clearly show natural variation in leaf pitch, azimuth, twist and smooth curvature around species arrangement, subtle asymmetry without crumpled or corkscrew leaves. Full plants framed with small close-up insets for attachments. No tiled copied foliage, no floating organs. Labels concise and readable.
